search_strategy: Logged into Mattermost via the REST API (POST /users/login), obtained a token and team id, and ran short keyword searches (ledger, dataset_signature, step_plan, tinker, ResumePlan; then cosine/decay/warmup; then reason, CHECKPOINT_REASONS, CHECKPOINT_NAME_TEMPLATE, resume) via /posts/search, printing only the first ~90 characters of each hit (step 27, line 2620-2649). These snippet-only searches recovered l1/l3/l8/l14/l15/l16 in full by luck (the informative half happened to be within 90 chars) but only the QUESTION half of g11.r1.l17 and the herring g11.r1.ledger-twin-checkpoints-dario's opening line -- both of which needed the reply that followed. The agent then dumped every channel to a per-channel .txt file under /tmp/mm (step ~30) and ran targeted grep -n (reason, CHECKPOINT_REASONS, resume, final) plus sed -n 'A,Bp' <channel>.txt reads on the resulting line ranges to read full threads. Most of these sed reads rendered as 'New Terminal Output' (cumulative, complete) but two -- releases.txt 320-370 (msg 89-90, line 3493) and releases.txt 515-570 (msg 89-90, line 3493 is actually the SECOND one; see lost_facts) -- rendered as a height-bounded 'Current Terminal Screen' that started partway through the requested range, silently dropping the TOP of both windows -- which happened to be exactly where g11.r1.l17's answer and the informative half of g11.r1.ledger-twin-checkpoints-dario sat. The agent also checked BookStack (wiki search, step ~22) and IMAP mail (step ~40) for finetuning/ledger/checkpoint/resume terms; both came back empty, correctly, since the plant record places all 47 g11 remarks in Mattermost chat only. Six remarks (l5(r1), l7(r1), l9(r1), l13(r1), l11(r2), l14(r2)) were never surfaced by any of these searches; all six facts they carry were nonetheless recovered because each requirement has multiple carriers (the spread invariant held).
